question: A ______ is used to detect acoustic signals under the water.
solution:
The correct answer is** __hydrophone.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A** hydrophone** is a gadget that detects and **records ocean sounds from all angles.**
 
• In reality, many aquatic species **utilise sound to communicate, reproduce, and hunt for food**​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ammeter,** a device used to** measure direct (DC) or alternating (AC) electric current in amperes.**
 
• Because just a tiny percentage of the current is routed through the metre at high values, an ammeter may measure a wide range of current values.
 
• **A pyrometer** is a device that** detects temperature remotely**, that is, without needing to come into touch with the item.
 
• **A bolometer** is a device that measures radiant heat using a temperature-dependent** electrical resistance substance.**
